ticks.note: Tick 1 enters M with regions R1 and R2.

Surprise: R1 checks the strong abort first (stop is still false), then sets stop = true. R2 must read stop after that write, so R2 sees stop = true and is aborted: its self-loop does not run (countR2 = 0). R1 is not aborted, so M is not left either (done = 0).

Now stop is true when R1 checks it: R1 is aborted too, M is left (done = 1). Neither self-loop ever ran (countR1 = 0, countR2 = 0). Avoid strong aborts whose trigger is written inside the aborted state.
